charge_port.notes: 2012: CHAdeMO optional on ES, standard on SE Premium, absent on SE (US owner thread); Wikipedia: optional US$750 on 2012 US cars. Trim split (one car record here): 2012 ES CHAdeMO optional, SE none, SE Premium standard; recorded as chademo, SE cars without it are J1772 only with no DC. Canadian cars: Mitsubishi Canada sheets (seen in a search result only) list CHAdeMO standard.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: CHAdeMO is the only DC port (Wikipedia) and Tesla Superchargers use NACS; no Mitsubishi adapter programme found for the i-MiEV.
